completed_milestones.milestone: Module 13: Connection Buttons Verification & Hardening (WhatsApp QR & IMAP Email)
completed_milestones.description: Fixed WhatsApp Baileys infinite 440 (connectionReplaced) reconnect loop by handling replaced sessions and adding generateQr() that clears stale creds for instant fresh QR generation; fixed missing saveAndSyncEmailChannel() in app.js and added IMAP timeouts to prevent network hangs.

completed_milestones.milestone: Module 14: Unified Email Config & Inbox Outbound Reply Dispatch
completed_milestones.description: Unified Email configuration across the entire app so Leads cold pitch dispatcher and Omnichannel Inbox share the same AES-256 encrypted SMTP credentials from channel_settings (axurabots@gmail.com). Fixed inbox reply endpoint (/inbox/conversations/:id/reply) to auto-resolve channel credentials and send email replies via SMTP. Verified live email delivery to blinknship@gmail.com.

current_checkpoint: Unified Email configuration across Leads and Inbox channels. Inbox email replies and cold pitches seamlessly resolve encrypted credentials from channel_settings. Dual port listening (3000 & 3005) enabled and node --watch active so browser sessions on either port instantly dispatch live SMTP emails.
